palabras: เปลี่ยนสินค้า

texto: Vocabulary for customer service, warranties and returns: «ใบเสร็จ» (bai-sèt, receipt / proof of purchase), «คืน» (khʉʉn, to return / to refund), «เปลี่ยนสินค้า» (bplìan sǐn-kháa, to exchange a product) and «เสีย» (sǐa, faulty / broken / out of order). To complain politely, describe the fault: «สินค้านี้เสีย ขอเปลี่ยนได้ไหม» (This product is faulty, can I exchange it?). The shop assistant will ask for the receipt, saying «ขอใบเสร็จด้วยครับ/ค่ะ» (The receipt as well, please). For refunds: «คืนเงิน» (refund).

opciones.texto: The customer service desk advises on official warranty procedures.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.
